definitions.detection: presence is label > 0; ViSFD OTHERS model 0/1 maps to semantic raw 0/4 and is included
definitions.pair: positive exact aspect-polarity hit over pair_scored_aspects; ViSFD OTHERS is excluded
definitions.pair_f1: micro F1 from pooled exact positive pairs, not flattened multiclass label accuracy
definitions.teacher_gap: descriptive teacher pair TP difference and paired transitions; no causal attribution
definitions.train_rarity: support and rare-class fields are computed from full TRAIN labels only
definitions.wrong_polarity: gold and prediction both present but exact pair label differs; one pair FP and one pair FN

limits: Teacher is one validation-selected E2 seed-42 run; no teacher variance is estimated.
E8 and E2 coefficients/checkpoints are compared conditional on their locked validation choices.
Teacher is a larger encoder fine-tuned separately; this does not reproduce the original Bami paper setup.
Argmax validation rows cannot establish why an error occurred or prove a distillation bottleneck.

definitions.conditional_polarity: pair-scored gold-present slots where both teacher and E8 predict present; exact polarity correctness
definitions.detection: all aspect slots; correct iff presence (label > 0) agrees, including ViSFD OTHERS
definitions.positive_pair: only pair-scored slots with gold present; hit iff exact gold polarity is predicted

selection.e8: NC plus LLRD, seed-specific saved validation artifact
